integrity: The accompanying all-parameter proof is self-contained. Finite verification is supplemental and is not represented as an infinite certificate. Earlier graph-theory results are credited; no external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classification is for finite connected simple bipartite graphs on \(2m\) vertices with \(m\ge3\) only. It does not settle general domination-number-two domatic perfection or general criticality. Priority beyond the cited and searched literature is not independently established.
title: Bipartite rigidity at half-order domatic number
